formData.name: Use the Right Equipment
formData.targetAudience: Johannesburg golfers who are using ill-suited clubs, struggling with consistency, or looking to improve their game through better equipment choices.
formData.context: Campaign theme: "You wouldn't dig a hole with a pool noodle. You wouldn't run a marathon in flip-flops. So why play golf with the wrong clubs?" Visual direction should compare obviously incorrect tools or equipment with golfers using unsuitable clubs. Focus on education, performance improvement, and the value of proper club selection and fitting.
formData.notes: Drive practice session and fitting bookings by educating golfers on the importance of using the correct clubs for their swing, skill level, and playing style. Reinforce that the right equipment leads to better performance, consistency, and enjoyment on the course.
